sources.title: HITEMP high-temperature molecular spectroscopic database
sources.supports: H2O high-temperature lines; database intended for temperature-dependent molecular absorption and emission. No F135 composition or pressure.

sources.title: Rothman et al. 2010 HITEMP
sources.supports: LTE line strengths require partition functions and temperature scaling. Hot bands missing from room-temperature lists can underestimate radiance. Weak near-IR/visible H2O transitions are included; spectral completeness is consequential.

sources.title: Cattaneo and Hernberg 2005 Detection of high-temperature water vapor at940nm
sources.supports: Heated-cell H2O line-strength measurements420–970K near940nm agree withHITRAN2004. This supports existence and calculability, not integrated F135 radiance or visible color.

sources.title: Claus1981 Spectral Flame Radiance From a Tubular-Can Combustor
sources.supports: JT8D combustor1.55–5.5um gas-band and soot continuum measurements; identifies water1.38/1.87/2.7/6.3um andCO2 bands. Not nozzle temperature orF135 loading.

sources.title: Zangmeister etal.2018 Measured In-situ Mass Absorption Spectra forNineForms
sources.supports: Flame-soot MAC5503.8–8.6m2/g; exponent1.0–1.3; measured500–840nm. Used as cross-source sensitivity, notF135 calibration; NIR extension past840nm is explicit extrapolation.

sources.title: You etal.2016 wavelength-dependent absorption
sources.supports: Pure laboratoryBC MAC5507.89±.25m2/g andAAE1.03±.09 over550–840nm. Mixingchangesproperties; no universalgraycoefficient.

sources.title: HamamatsuS16008-66
sources.supports: Anexample silicon detector spans380–1100nm. Not the footagecamera oritsQE.

sources.title: BaslerCamerasforFluorescenceMicroscopy
sources.supports: Colorcamera IRcut may block above approximately650–700nm. Motivates cutoff sensitivity, not a claim about the footage.

sources.title: AxisLightingforNetworkVideo
sources.supports: Silicon camera NIR can contaminate allRGBchannels; actualday/nightmode often outputsgrayscale withIRcut removed. NIR isnot intrinsically red/orange andnightdoesnotidentify filterstate.

sources.title: NAVSEA2025 Carderock F35B JSKaga deckthermaltesting
sources.supports: Heating/cooling anddeckthermalload are real; no measuredvisibleincandescence, spectralresponse, ornumericaltemperaturesgiven.
